shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the upper marker at x = 1 in the left image with the marker at 1 beside the gray region in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oblique branch excludes its x = 1 endpoint. Right image: The shaded overlap excludes the upper boundary 1.
